title: Settings
llmIntro: Select a provider and fill in the API key to get started.
baseUrlPlaceholder: https://api.anthropic.com (leave blank to use the official address)
baseUrlHelp: Internal gateway / proxy address, e.g. http://192.168.2.197:3000
modelPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default model
defaultModel: Default: {{model}} (the server uses it automatically when blank)
darkGlassDesc: High contrast, good for long sessions
replayIntro: When a step is blocked from mechanical execution, the step's natural-language instruction lets AI take over on the fly (counts as passed with an “AI fallback execution” mark on success; the original failure is kept on failure).
locatorFallbackTitle: Automatically fall back to AI execution when mechanical execution fails
locatorFallbackDesc: Re-runs the step from its instruction when mechanical execution errors (locator failed, assertion mismatch, etc.).
assistantIntro: Shared configuration for the AI assistant: MCP servers and skills apply to all projects and load on new sessions.
assistantMemoryIntro: Knowledge the assistant accumulates: memories distilled in-session, trajectories from successful case generation. Injected into later tasks on the same product line; view and delete here.
assistantPromptIntro: System prompt and tool copy are editable with version-chain rollback; solidify scans distill cross-line experience into proposals — the LLM only proposes, every apply goes through human approval.
memoryIntro: Product-line scoped short-term memory: experiences the assistant distills on its own (write gating built into the save_memory tool); index auto-injected into later sessions on the same line. View and delete only.
memoryDeleteConfirm: Delete memory "{{name}}"? It will no longer be injected into the assistant context.
trajectoryIntro: Product-line scoped successful case-generation trajectories (auto-distilled by the post-solidify hook; criteria = verify passed in a real run + case confirmed saved). Retrieved and referenced by case-creation tasks on the same line; view and delete only.
trajectoryDeleteConfirm: Delete trajectory "{{name}}"? It will no longer be injected into the assistant context.
promptIntro: Assistant system prompt and tool copy. Without a custom value each module follows the code default (evolves with releases); edits affect new sessions only.
promptSkillReadonlyHint: Skill bodies are read-only — revise via solidify proposals or skill-creator; rollback writes back to disk.
promptRestoreDefaultConfirm: Restore to "follow code default"? History is kept; the current custom value is replaced.
promptRollbackConfirm: Roll back to version {{seq}}? A new version row is appended; history is kept.
solidifyIntro: Distills cross-product-line general experience from memories and trajectories into proposals — the LLM only proposes; every apply goes through human approval.
solidifyProposalNone: No proposals — distilled results appear here after a scan.
mcpIntro: External tools the AI assistant can call. Globally shared; changes apply to new sessions.
skillsIntro: The assistant's skill library. Each skill is a directory tree on the server (SKILL.md + references/ agents/ scripts/ …); bundled scripts are run via run_skill_script, guarded by a timeout and output cap. Globally shared.
skillNameInvalid: Name may only contain lowercase letters/digits/hyphens (no leading/trailing - and no consecutive --)
skillDescriptionPlaceholder: One sentence about what it does
skillCreateIsSkeleton: This form saves metadata only; creating writes a SKILL.md skeleton. Edit/upload content under “Manage files”, or have the assistant create a full skill in one call via manage_skill with files[], or import from GitHub with import_skill.
skillFileSelectFirst: Select a file on the left
skillFileIsDir: This is a directory. Uploads land inside it.
skillFileTruncated: File is large; only the first 60KB is shown (saving will replace it with the truncated content)
skillFileDeleteConfirm: Delete file “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
skillUploadHint: Uploads go to the current selection: a selected directory receives them, a selected file means its own directory; directories are never created.
skillDeleteAlsoDir: Skill content lives in a directory on the server; deleting removes that whole directory and cannot be undone.
feedbackIntro: Thumbs up/down and written comments users submit in assistant conversations. Collected only — nothing is applied automatically.
